records.question: What is the reported average coral cover on reef slopes in American Samoa according to the Executive Summary?
records.ground_truth_answer: Average coral cover on reef slopes is now 31%.
ground_truth_chunks: - Average coral cover on reef slopes is now 31%, higher than the averages for the Pacific, South Pacific, U.S. Pacific, Great Barrier Reef, and Caribbean. The latter two have just 10% and 8% coral cover left. Coral cover is lower than it was here before crown-of-thorns starfish ate almost all the coral in 1978, and lower than it was in the past in the Pacific and Caribbean.

records.question: What was the mean number of coral species recorded in one-hour roving biodiversity dives at core sites (outside the harbor)?
ground_truth_chunks: The mean number of species in the core sites (outside the harbor) was 61, and for the sites in the harbor it was 40 (shown more clearly in Figure 41).
There was no overlap in the number of species in the two groups.

records.question: Which coral genus had the most cover on reef flats?
ground_truth_chunks: *Acropora* is the genus with the most cover on reef flats, followed by *Montipora*, *Porites*, *Pavona*, and *Pocillopora*.

records.question: What was the average coral cover overall on Ofu-Olosega reef flats in 2011?
records.ground_truth_answer: Average coral cover overall was just under 20%.
ground_truth_chunks: Average coral cover overall was just under 20%, close to that on Tutuila when reef flats were first surveyed in 2007 (Figure 67).

records.question: Which coral genera did the author report as diseased in Vatia?
records.ground_truth_answer: Acropora and Pocillopora (including a digitate Acropora identified as A. monticulosa).
ground_truth_chunks: All I saw was on > *Acropora* and *Pocillopora*.
A digitate *Acropora* species that has > pyramid-shaped branchlets, *A. monticulosa*, virtually every colony had it, > and some were completely dead.

records.question: What debris item did Doug report finding during the dive at Leone?
records.ground_truth_answer: A ladder that was built to get into a boat (it curved at the top to hold on to the edge of the boat).
ground_truth_chunks: I only saw one item of debris, it was a ladder that was built to get into a boat with (it curved at the top to hold on to the edge of the boat).
But I saw no other debris.

records.question: What macroalgae is mostly present on the lower slope at Amaua?
ground_truth_chunks: That lower slope has high macroalgae cover which is mostly *Halimeda*, but also has some low mounds of *Lobophyllia* coral, and below that some *Mycedium* plates.

records.question: How tall are the "microatolls" of Porites on the Vatia reef flat?
ground_truth_chunks: These "microatolls" are very short rings of live coral that can be up to around 1 m diameter, but only about 2-4 cm tall.

records.question: What species of staghorn coral is reported as the most common in the pool in front of the eastern part of the malai in Alofau?
ground_truth_chunks: The pool in front of the eastern part of the malai in Alofau has fairly murky water with 8 m visibility currently.
The coral is all staghorn, mostly *Acropora muricata*.

records.question: How many coral reef fish species are known in American Samoa?
records.ground_truth_answer: About 945 species of coral reef fish are known.
